gloss: entering a garage/warehouse; stocking in; returning to depot

definitions.gloss: warehousing; putting goods into a warehouse; stocking in
definitions.explanation: The act of bringing goods or inventory into a warehouse or storeroom and registering them as stock. Standard logistics and retail term; contrasts with {出庫|しゅっこ} ('shipping out; stock out').

definitions.gloss: (a train, bus, etc.) returning to the depot/garage; (a car) entering a parking garage
definitions.explanation: The act of a vehicle going back into its garage, depot, or parking structure. Used for trains returning to rail yards at the end of service, buses going back to the depot, or a car entering a parking garage.

examples.english: When entering the multi-story parking garage, please move forward slowly.

notes:
Compound of {入|にゅう} ('enter') and {庫|こ} ('storehouse; garage'). Functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb: {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. The direct antonym is {出庫|しゅっこ} ('stock out; leaving the depot').

USAGE:
Sense 1 is the logistics/retail meaning — very common in business contexts. Sense 2 is about vehicles returning to their base, common on station/bus-stop signage and announcements. Both uses are standard written and spoken Japanese within their respective domains; everyday conversation rarely uses this word outside workplace contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: scheduled to come into stock
- {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: warehousing/stock-in work
- {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: stock-in confirmation
- {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: stock-in processing (in inventory systems)
- ⟦{車庫|しゃこ}→車庫：00361_shako⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to return to the depot
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to enter a parking garage
- {入庫|にゅうこ}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: already stocked in / already at the depot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出庫|しゅっこ}: stocking out; leaving the depot — direct antonym
- ⟦{入荷|にゅうか}→入荷：07939_nyuuka⟧: receiving merchandise (the shipment arriving at a store) — closely related to sense 1, but emphasizes arrival rather than placement into storage
- ⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧: delivery of goods (to a customer/store) — from the supplier's side
- ⟦{搬入|はんにゅう}→搬入：16523_hannyuu⟧: carrying in; bringing in (goods, equipment) — physical transport act

TRANSITIVITY / PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- Goods as subject: 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('goods come into stock')
- With destination: 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to enter/return to [warehouse/depot]')
- Transitive: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{入庫|にゅうこ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ('to stock/warehouse [something]')
